label: WHO WE ARE
heading: Afghan Support Phoenix
statement: We support Afghan individuals and families through legal services, community resources, and integration support.
body1: We support Afghan individuals and families through legal services, community resources, and integration support. Our team speaks your language and understands your journey. All services are free and confidential.
body2: A program of Catholic Charities Community Services, Arizona — serving our community with dignity and compassion since 1933.
